## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes (format, typecheck, lint, unit tests with coverage)
- [ ] `bun run build:lib`, `bun run lint:package`, `bun run size` and `bun run test:pack` pass, if the module's code or its package files changed
- [ ] `bun run test:e2e` passes, if a playground, the demo or the client behavior changed
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] Docs and the README are updated
- [ ] `packages/nuxt-penumbra/CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
